description: This file defines functions and data structures for retrieving and parsing netfilter conntrack statistics from the Linux filesystem, specifically from the 'nf_conntrack' file, and includes a data structure representing individual conntrack statistic entries.

classes.name: ConntrackStatEntry
classes.description: Represents one line of netfilter conntrack statistics at a CPU core, containing various counters such as entries, searched, found, etc.

methods.name: FS.ConntrackStat
methods.description: Retrieves netfilter's conntrack statistics, split by CPU cores.

methods.name: readConntrackStat
methods.description: Reads and parses the conntrack statistics file into a slice of ConntrackStatEntry.

methods.name: parseConntrackStat
methods.description: Parses the contents of a conntrack statistics file into a slice of ConntrackStatEntry objects.

methods.name: parseConntrackStatEntry
methods.description: Parses a single conntrack statistic entry from an array of string fields.
